title: Bullet: Boosting GPU Utilization for LLM Serving through Spatial-Temporal GPU Resource Sharing
authors: Zejia Lin; Hongxin Xu; Guanyi Chen; Zhiguang Chen; Yutong Lu; Xianwei Zhang
venue_full: ACM International Conference on Architectural Support for Programming Languages and Operating Systems (ASPLOS 2026)
research_focus: LLM serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis, Hardware co-design, MoE serving

problem_statement.en: Hybrid prefill/decode batching leaves GPUs under-utilised because prefill is compute-intensive while decode is memory-bound. Existing systems treat the two phases as a single shared batch, so they either protect latency by throttling prefill or protect throughput by allowing prefill to disrupt decode.
problem_statement.zh: 混合 prefill/decode batching 會讓 GPU 利用率不足，因為 prefill 偏 compute-bound，而 decode 偏 memory-bound。既有系統把兩個階段放在同一共享 batch 裡處理，結果不是為了保護延遲而限制 prefill，就是為了吞吐而讓 prefill 干擾 decode。

key_innovation.en: Bullet is a spatial-temporal orchestration system that co-executes prefill and decode while dynamically provisioning streaming multiprocessor resources. It combines an SM-scaling roofline model, SLO-aware scheduling, SM masking via libsmctrl, and a concurrent execution engine so prefill can consume otherwise idle compute resources without violating decode latency.
key_innovation.zh: Bullet 是一個 spatial-temporal orchestration 系統，讓 prefill 與 decode 可並行執行，並動態配置 streaming multiprocessor 資源。它結合 SM-scaling roofline model、SLO-aware scheduling、透過 libsmctrl 的 SM masking、以及 concurrent execution engine，使 prefill 能利用閒置 compute 資源，同時不破壞 decode latency。

key_improvements.en: Reports 1.26x average throughput gain and up to 1.55x over state-of-the-art systems while meeting latency targets. On multi-GPU Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 serving, Bullet lowers mean latency, TTFT, and TPOT by 17.7x, 16.2x, and 4.2x versus vLLM in the reported configuration; utilisation analysis shows 86.2% active SM cycles and higher Tensor Core and memory-bandwidth utilisation than SGLang.
key_improvements.zh: 在滿足 latency target 下，平均 throughput 提升 1.26x，最高達 1.55x。於多 GPU Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8 服務設定中，Bullet 相對 vLLM 分別將 mean latency、TTFT、TPOT 降低 17.7x、16.2x、4.2x；利用率分析顯示 active SM cycles 達 86.2%，Tensor Core 與 memory bandwidth 利用率也高於 SGLang。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 80GB, NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA H20, HBM
reported_accuracy: SM-scaling roofline model reports mean absolute relative error for decode of 10.5% over 7360 profiled configurations; end-to-end validation is reported through throughput, latency, and SLO-compliance metrics.

scope_assumptions.en: Bullet assumes the serving runtime can enforce SM-level partitioning and run prefill/decode in separate execution streams. Its model is calibrated for specific GPU generations and uses runtime performance estimation rather than a fully portable closed-form predictor across arbitrary kernels and hardware.
scope_assumptions.zh: Bullet 假設服務 runtime 能執行 SM-level partitioning，並以不同 execution streams 分開執行 prefill/decode。其模型針對特定 GPU 世代校準，使用 runtime performance estimation，而不是可任意跨 kernel 與硬體移植的完整 closed-form predictor。
